title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $250.01 on the Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro robot vacuum and mop
excerpt: Get extra cleaning assistance this fall.
content_html:
SAVE OVER $200: As of Sept. 18, the Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro robot vacuum and mop is on sale for $549.98 at Amazon, its lowest-ever price. Compared to its full price of $799.99, you're saving $250.01.

Credit: Roborock

$549.98 at Amazon
$799.99 Save $250.01

Prime Big Deal Days is still weeks away, but Amazon is already dropping robot vacuum deals.

If your home needs a little extra cleaning help this fall, Roborock's Qrevo 2 Pro robot vacuum and mop (which launched in the U.S. just last month) is on sale at its lowest-ever price.

As of Sept. 18, this sleek combo cleaner has been slashed from $799.99 to $549.98. Overall, that's about $250 in savings, which is a pretty sweet offer to jump on before the October Prime Day sale begins. However, keep in mind it is marked as a "limited time deal," so you don't have long to save.

Roborock's latest launch is a powerful pick for cleaning your floors. Hair, crumbs, and dust are no match for its 20,000 Pa HyperForce suction, and the cleaner even automatically boosts suction on carpets to clear up lodged debris. There's no need to worry about hair tangles, as it features an anti-tangle side brush and DuoDivide main brush to help minimize hair wrap.

This robot vacuum features a FlexiArm Edge Mopping System that helps reach edges and get in as close as 1.85mm along walls. It even lifts the mopping module up to 15mm when it hits carpet, so there's no need to worry about your textile floors getting wet as the cleaner moves around the house. Plus, it comes with Obstacle Avoidance technology that helps it navigate around objects on the floor.
